synthesis.trait: Self-medicates with alcohol and gambling to cope with stress/tension
Maintains calm, controlled composure under pressure despite visible inner tension
Deflects confrontation and emotional pain with crude jokes and insults
Holds to a personal philosophy that willful blindness ('see no evil, hear no evil') is how people survive
Uses calibrated, consent-based persuasion tactics with reluctant witnesses to extract information
Cycles through baseball pitch grips as a private stress-coping ritual
Reacts with clipped avoidance/denial when confronted about his baseball-playing past
Willing to defy direct orders/warnings and escalate physical risk in pursuit of a lead

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Uses calibrated, consent-based persuasion tactics with reluctant witnesses to extract information
turning_points.what_changes: The playful, consent-based deal ('if he can't hit it, you tell me') used on a child gives way to an explicit threat of ICE deportation against a frightened adult -- leverage shifts from a game to institutional coercion.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Uses calibrated, consent-based persuasion tactics with reluctant witnesses to extract information
turning_points.what_changes: Verbal/legal coercion escalates to physical force -- he grabs and pins Cheyenne, someone with intimate personal history, against a wall to compel disclosure, the first time this extraction method becomes bodily.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Uses calibrated, consent-based persuasion tactics with reluctant witnesses to extract information
turning_points.what_changes: The same confrontation continues unbroken: he disarms O'Shea and locks everyone in the car, extending the physical-coercion turn from the immediately preceding beat.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Willing to defy direct orders/warnings and escalate physical risk in pursuit of a lead
turning_points.what_changes: Directly executes the decision made moments earlier to defy Doug's warning, infiltrating the woodworking plant under a false identity ('Mr. Matthews') -- the immediate follow-through of the same choice.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Willing to defy direct orders/warnings and escalate physical risk in pursuit of a lead
turning_points.what_changes: His single-minded pursuit goes from deception (low risk) to reckless physical action that knocks down and injures an innocent disabled bystander -- exposing a previously unseen blind spot: his tunnel-vision focus can cause collateral harm to people who have nothing to do with the case.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Willing to defy direct orders/warnings and escalate physical risk in pursuit of a lead
turning_points.what_changes: The unbroken continuation of the same rooftop chase, culminating in a flying tackle that brings both men crashing to the ground -- the physical payoff of the collateral-harm-risking pursuit begun in the prior beat.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Willing to defy direct orders/warnings and escalate physical risk in pursuit of a lead
turning_points.what_changes: Moves from chasing and tackling a fleeing stranger to premeditated armed breaking-and-entering -- alone, with his father's rifle, forcing open a locked door on private property in anticipation of confrontation.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Willing to defy direct orders/warnings and escalate physical risk in pursuit of a lead
turning_points.what_changes: Carrying a weapon for readiness becomes an actual exchange of gunfire -- Reggie shoots to kill, John blocks the blast with a door and returns fire, the first time this trait crosses into mutual lethal violence.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Willing to defy direct orders/warnings and escalate physical risk in pursuit of a lead
turning_points.what_changes: The same gunfight continues without a gap -- a second exchange of shots wounds Reggie, directly extending the lethal confrontation just begun.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Willing to defy direct orders/warnings and escalate physical risk in pursuit of a lead
turning_points.what_changes: Despite having just exchanged lethal gunfire with a man who tried to kill him, John offers to call for medical help ('Let me make a call') -- revealing a limit to his ruthlessness: ready to kill in self-defense, but not to let an enemy die needlessly once the threat is down.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Maintains calm, controlled composure under pressure despite visible inner tension
turning_points.what_changes: The outward calm established at the very start ('seems calm, but eyes always tense') completely collapses into screaming rage and a self-inflicted shoulder injury -- revealing a breaking point beneath the composure that had never before cracked on-screen.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Reacts with clipped avoidance/denial when confronted about his baseball-playing past
turning_points.what_changes: The clipped 'No' refusal to discuss playing ball again is fully unpacked for the first time -- revealing the concealed reason: guilt over piloting the boat that killed his best friend Andy, a vulnerability never previously disclosed.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Holds to a personal philosophy that willful blindness ('see no evil, hear no evil') is how people survive
turning_points.what_changes: Moves from a cynical observation about how bystanders survive by ignoring evil to personally practicing that blindness himself, deciding to keep his own father's criminal involvement secret from the Captain at the cost of his integrity as a detective.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Holds to a personal philosophy that willful blindness ('see no evil, hear no evil') is how people survive
turning_points.what_changes: Escalates from passively protecting his dead father's secret to actively enabling his living sister's escape after she confesses to killing a child -- handing her his rental keys and telling her 'it's between you and God now,' a far higher-stakes act of obstruction than silence.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Holds to a personal philosophy that willful blindness ('see no evil, hear no evil') is how people survive
turning_points.what_changes: The direct, unbroken continuation of the same choice -- saying goodbye as he completes the decision to let Trudy go.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Holds to a personal philosophy that willful blindness ('see no evil, hear no evil') is how people survive
turning_points.what_changes: Physically executes the plan, driving off in Trudy's car to cover her escape -- the direct continuation of the choice made moments before.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Holds to a personal philosophy that willful blindness ('see no evil, hear no evil') is how people survive
turning_points.what_changes: After a lifetime of practicing willful blindness for survival -- stated as his philosophy at the story's opening and twice enacted at escalating personal cost -- he does the opposite in the film's final beat, voluntarily confessing the truth about killing Andy to Andy's parents, breaking his own survival code by choosing disclosure over self-protective blindness for the first time.
